reserveReview.rationale: At BSC blocks 136026125 to 136026382 (2026-11-27T10:54:42Z to 10:56:37Z), Sigma Money's PoolManager (0x0a43ca87954ed1799b7b072f6e9d51d88cca600e) directly held 592.630959489545409660 WBNB (333,455.59 USD at 562.67 USD/WBNB, 86.39%) and 90.001398405087421594 SY-clisBNB (52,530.96 USD at 583.67 USD/SY-clisBNB, 13.61%), totalling 385,986.55 USD against bnbUSD totalSupply of 347,648.321911941000961794 (111.03% on-chain collateralization). Accounting reconciles completely across both registered SigmaLongPool markets: WBNB long pool (0x31c464cfe506d44ceaa86c05cdbb94b5c94f70fb) recorded 597.331914 WBNB collateral and 309,474.44 bnbUSD debt, with the 4.70 WBNB above PoolManager's idle balance accounted for by 4.601916 WBNB lent to ShortPoolManager (0x8e473cdcdeb8dfaa41f92e3b4a284e134ac4acb2) and 0.10 WBNB in YieldStrategy (0xd69a0ab6dfe41ba46e9f75e49a5349c8a2daa0ca); SY-clisBNB long pool (0xe8a16f808412c4341f692b49c81d64c374187b7d) recorded 90.101398 SY-clisBNB collateral (93.629231 BNB equivalent via Lista StakeManager rate 1.039784) and 38,131.78 bnbUSD debt, with 0.10 SY-clisBNB in its allocation contract. Pool debt sums to 347,606.22 bnbUSD (99.988% of totalSupply; 42.10 bnbUSD residual). Sigma's documented Lista DAO idle-asset yield strategy (ListaStrategyV2 0x6dbc0204fd0bb1e7941f08392d13963534936668) is marked sunset in official docs and read principal=0 and totalSupply=0 at the pin. The live evm-branch-balances adapter monitors direct PoolManager WBNB and SY-clisBNB balances against bnbUSD.totalSupply() every run, conservatively excluding the small short-pool and YieldStrategy allocations.

reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Both registered long-pool collateral tokens (WBNB and SY-clisBNB over Lista slisBNB) are identified and measured on-chain with zero unclassified residual; the live adapter conservatively excludes 4.60 WBNB lent to the short pool and 0.10 WBNB / 0.10 SY-clisBNB in YieldStrategy allocations. Open items outside composition gaps: PoolManager and SigmaClisBNBSY are upgradeable under a 6-of-9 Safe with no timelock; idle assets could be reallocated via PoolManager.alloc() / manage() (up to 80% documented cap in prior Lista strategy); and no independent reserve attestation exists.

PoolManager also supports allocating collateral to external yield strategies and lending WBNB to the ShortPoolManager counterparty.
